ILLINOIS STATE SENATE
DON A. MOORE STATE SENATOR STH DISTRICT
May 14, 1974
Matthew L. Rockwell, Executive Director Northeastern Illinois Planning Commission 10 South Riverside Plaza Chicago, Illinois 60606
Re: NIPC PROJECT #7
Dear Mr. Rockwell:
Please accept this correspondence in regard to the above captioned project. It is my recommendation that the Federal Grant requested of $9,229,000 be approved to assist with this project.
If I can be of any further assistance, please do not hesitate to contact me.
Very truly yours,
SENATOR DON A. MOORE
